inlines.v: SUBPE'NA, noun [Latin sub and poena, pain, penalty.] A writ commanding the attendance in court of the person on whom it is served; as witnesses, etc. SUBPE'NA, verb transitive To serve with a writ of subpena; to command attendance in court by a legal writ.
